content: {"question":"If a GitLab employee in Italy wants to use a coaching vendor other than SoundingBoard, will the coaching reimbursement be tax‑free and can the cost be charged directly to the company cost center?","answer":"Yes, the coaching reimbursement will be tax‑free under Art. 51(2)(f) and Art. 100 TUIR, and the cost can be routed directly to the appropriate cost center because GitLab has a direct relationship with SoundingBoard and can accept other vendors if noted in the request.","evidence_a":"Coaching through the G&D Fund is available to team members at the Manager level and above. If you would prefer to use a different coaching vendor, please note that in your request so the team can review it as part of the approval process.","evidence_b":"Professional Coaching | Tax‑free. Qualifies under two legal bases: (1) Art. 51(1) TUIR as expense in the exclusive interest of the employer when directly job‑related; (2) Art. 51(2)(f) + Art. 100 TUIR as education benefit when offered to all employees or homogeneous categories for professional development purposes."}
